The moment you understand that your time is a finite asset, you stop spending it with people who value comfort over growth.

Solitude is cheaper than forced alignment.

Fun fact: You are currently paying a tax on everything you don't know.

It is called ignorance debt, and it is the most expensive thing you own.

How to know if you are winning: You are no longer looking for validation from the people you are trying to outperform.

Quiet work is the only signal that matters.
